title: Poland: Minister of Health regulation on the list of psychotropic substances, narcotic drugs and new psychoactive substances (consolidated text announced 17 June 2024; later amendments not incorporated), read together with Art. 31-34 of the Act on Counteracting Drug Addiction
license: Official legislative text; only short list entries are quoted

entries.quote: Załącznik nr 2, ŚRODKI ODURZAJĄCE GRUPY II-N: KODEINA
entries.note: Group II-N: may be used only for medical, industrial or research purposes (Act Art. 33(1)); possession only by authorised persons (Art. 34). Group III-N covers some low-dose codeine preparations. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule.

entries.quote: Załącznik nr 2, ŚRODKI ODURZAJĄCE GRUPY I-N: KONOPI ZIELE innych niż włókniste oraz wyciągi, nalewki farmaceutyczne, a także wszystkie inne wyciągi z konopi innych niż włókniste
entries.note: Group I-N: medical, industrial or research use only (Act Art. 33(1)); non-medical use is not permitted. Medical cannabis is covered by Art. 33a. Control-list classification, not a personal-import rule.
